preview.notFoundHint: This sample may have been reset, or this address is not part of the prototype.

preview.required: Name or last name is required.
preview.keyLength: External key must contain at most 80 characters in this preview.
preview.missingAccount: Select an account from this sample workspace.
preview.pilotObserved: Pilot scenario observed; no claim for every field or state.
preview.candidateSubset: Implemented for the fixed Account/Contact candidate subset.
preview.candidateLength: Candidate length alignment implemented from the bounded declaration evidence; not universal metadata parity.
preview.implemented: Candidate route implemented; prototype does not call it.
preview.relationshipSubset: Contact.Account.Name projection and AccountId equality filter supported by the candidate.
preview.simLists: Fixed synthetic rows in a local Pinia store.
preview.limitLists: No search, pagination or broad query fidelity claim. Plans 5/10 foundation evidence remains blocked.
preview.simFields: Forms use a deliberately small field selection and candidate-aligned 80-character key rule.
preview.limitFields: No dynamic schema or effective-permission parity claim. Unicode length behavior remains unmeasured here.
preview.simRead: Local lookup by synthetic record ID.
preview.limitRead: Missing samples display a proposed not-found screen, not a measured API error presentation.
preview.simWrites: Create and edit affect in-memory sample data only. Reload or reset restores fixtures.
preview.limitWrites: No request, transaction or durable save occurs. Required-field presentation is proposed UX.
preview.simRelationships: Local account picker, Contact link and computed Account-related Contacts list.
preview.limitRelationships: No reverse-relationship or lookup-search endpoint is claimed. Reference pilot relationship behavior does not certify every proposed UI interaction.
preview.simUx: Theme, language, drawer, reset and validation presentation are local product UX.
preview.limitUx: Not Salesforce UI evidence, authentication, sharing or production readiness.
preview.evidenceIntro: Known routes, observed behavior and implemented features are separate facts. Every interaction here is simulated.
preview.listIntroAccounts: A place for the organizations you work with.

preview.noContacts: No related contacts in this sample.
preview.newHint: Try the proposed form. Saving creates a sample in this tab only.
preview.editHint: Explore editing. Your changes affect sample data only.
preview.formRequired: Required fields are marked with an asterisk.
preview.prototypeFields: A focused first slice. More fields will follow the evidence.
